def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {v for row in grid for v in row}}
    bar=max((v for v in counts if v!=bg), key=counts.get)
    dot=next(v for v in counts if v not in (bg,bar))
    for r in (0,h-1):
        cols=[c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==bar]
        if not cols: continue
        lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols); k=(hi-lo+1)//2
        # Select the half of the bar facing the grid center.
        selected=range(hi-k+1,hi+1) if (lo+hi)/2 < (w-1)/2 else range(lo,lo+k)
        for c in selected:
            rows=range(1,h) if r==0 else range(h-2,-1,-1)
            for rr in rows:
                if grid[rr][c]==dot:
                    a[rr][c]=4
                    break
                a[rr][c]=dot
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j]==dot: a[i][j]=4
    return a
PY
